regions.merged_text: PIUS X TO DELEGATION OF CLERGY AND LAITY FROM DIOCESES OF ITALY "You have thanked me for the little good I have been able to do during the 5 years of my pontificate. My program, my star, my banner has always been the same; To restore all things in Christ, that is to strive that all men, were that possible, but es- pecially all Christians, should live ac- cording to the profession of their faith in the holy law of Jesus Christ. This is my continuous desire, my continual recom- mendation, this is my daily sermon if I may say so. And this restoration of all things in Christ we must seek first of all in ourselves. We must try to live the very life of Jesus Christ, in holiness and warmth of faith, in keeping from us, aught that is displeasing to the Heart of Our Redeemer.
